transcript.answer: Otto's conversations started surviving an api restart on 2026-09-30. That is when PR #300, "Persist support conversations through HAL Engine's MongoSessionStore", was merged at 10:25 UTC. It closed issue #296. The change makes the api build its HAL Engine with a MongoSessionStore instead of the in-memory default. Before it, a restart destroyed every conversation. Issue #23, closed 2026-09-23, was the earlier umbrella issue for persistence. #296 says Otto owns no store of its own and that the persistence comes from HAL Engine 0.4.0, so the restart behaviour changed with #300.
